business_summary: Tianjin Benefo Tejing Electric Co., Ltd. operates in the power equipment industry in China and internationally. The company offers electric control distribution accessories and molds, such as terminal blocks, switch, heavy duty connectors, isolators, transmitter, switching power supply, and relay; electromagnetic wire, copper busbar, and coil; and low voltage electrical products, including baili smart, molded case, miniature, and intelligent universal circuit breaker, as well as automatic transfer switch. It also provides solid insulation vacuum circuit breaker, outdoor ring main unit, intelligent center cabinet, gas-filled cabinet, intelligent low voltage switchgear, and prefabricated substation; and medium voltage epoxy resin vacuum casting transformer; indoor metal armored withdrawable, indoor metal clad removable, and low voltage withdrawable switchgear, as well as high voltage vacuum and high voltage sulfur hexafluoride circuit breaker. In addition, the company offers high temperature superconducting wire, low-leakage high-temperature superconducting current lead, high temperature superconducting coils and magnets, and high-temperature superconductivity demonstration and experimental device; three screw, twin screw, single screw, centrifugal, gear, and jet pumps; and reactive power compensation equipment comprising high voltage and low voltage static var generator, flexible DC transmission and distribution equipment, low voltage energy storage converter, three-phase imbalance intelligent management device, low voltage active filter, series capacitor compensation device, and dynamic VAR compensation device. Further, it provides high temperature superconductors, pumps, electrical connection parts supporting, and intelligent power distribution integration solutions. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Tianjin, China. Tianjin Benefo Tejing Electric Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Tianjin Hydraulic & Machine (Group) Co., Ltd.
